title: Protein Precipitation Extraction Method
author: Idha Arfianti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3xrgpm6

steps.title: Thaw plasma sample
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen plasma at room temperature (25 ± 1 °C).

steps.title: Homogenize thawed plasma
steps.instruction: Vortex the thawed plasma to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Add internal standard and ACN
steps.instruction: To each 100 µL plasma aliquot add 50 µL internal standard (2 µg/mL) then add 250 µL acetonitrile.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture, shake for 5 seconds, then centrifuge for 2 minutes at 14 800 rpm.

steps.title: Filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant through a 0.2 µm syringe filter and transfer the filtrate to a new vial.

steps.title: Inject into LC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Inject 2 µL of the filtered sample into the LC‑MS/MS system.
